statement: NDC reports December 2021-February 2022 floods and landslides damaged infrastructure, agriculture and WASH; recovery cost $37.5m, about 7% of 2022 GDP.
compact_statement: NDC reports December 2021-February 2022 floods and landslides damaged infrastructure, agriculture and WASH; recovery cost $37.5m, about 7% of 2022 GDP.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.3, PDF p. 67 (one-based), flood and landslide loss-and-damage summary.

uncertainty: NDC attributes the recovery estimate to an IFRC 2024 country plan.

statement: NDC cites annual flood losses rising from 1.9% of GDP in 2020 to 2.8% by 2050 and 4.1% by 2080.
compact_statement: NDC cites annual flood losses rising from 1.9% of GDP in 2020 to 2.8% by 2050 and 4.1% by 2080.
scenario: Cited assessment incorporates RCP4.5 and RCP8.5; NDC does not assign the loss figures to one pathway.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.3.1, PDF p. 68 (one-based), projected economic losses.

uncertainty: Figures are reproduced from the World Bank's 2024 national flood-risk assessment.

statement: NDC states fisheries provide 70-85% of animal protein and support 15% of active workers; extreme weather and erosion damage boats and isolate communities.
compact_statement: NDC states fisheries provide 70-85% of animal protein and support 15% of active workers; extreme weather and erosion damage boats and isolate communities.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.1.2, PDF p. 51 (one-based), fisheries exposure and impacts.

uncertainty: Fisheries baseline figures are attributed to World Bank 2017.

statement: NDC says falling catches push artisanal fishers farther offshore; Gulf of Guinea evidence elsewhere suggests maritime-crime exposure and fleet competition may rise.
compact_statement: NDC says falling catches push artisanal fishers farther offshore; Gulf of Guinea evidence elsewhere suggests maritime-crime exposure and fleet competition may rise.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.1.2, PDF p. 52 (one-based), artisanal fishing and maritime-crime discussion.

uncertainty: Crime-risk link is analogical evidence from elsewhere, not measured local incidence.

statement: SCD reports recurrent floods, landslides, erosion and storms threaten lives, livelihoods, the airport and primary roads concentrated along the coast.
compact_statement: SCD reports recurrent floods, landslides, erosion and storms threaten lives, livelihoods, the airport and primary roads concentrated along the coast.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 3, printed pp. 70-71 (PDF pp. 85-86), coastal hazards and exposed infrastructure.

uncertainty: Diagnostic describes exposure, not asset-level damage probabilities.

statement: World Bank climate data show 1951-2010 warming of 1.5°C, mean rainfall falling 1.7 mm yearly, and March-May rainfall dropping 10.5 mm monthly.
compact_statement: World Bank climate data show 1951-2010 warming of 1.5°C, mean rainfall falling 1.7 mm yearly, and March-May rainfall dropping 10.5 mm monthly.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 3, printed p. 72 (PDF p. 87), historical climate observations.

uncertainty: Historical trends use Climate Change Knowledge Portal data and polynomial fits.
